## Grading Criteria Checklist

The following checklist was used to ensure that all grading criteria were met and that our Git workflow was properly followed.

### Project Structure
- [x] Clear and complete `README.md` and `LICENSE` files included.
- [x] Complete `IEAP-Series02-Rstudio.qmd` file and corresponding PDF included.
- [x] Clean folder structure with subfolders and sub-documents.
- [x] Sub-documents used so team members could work on different sections simultaneously.

### Git Workflow
- [x] Separate branches created for different sections.
- [x] Meaningful commit messages used, with at least one commit per question.
- [x] Changes pushed regularly to GitHub.
- [x] Team members reviewed each other's Pull Requests to recheck the work before merging.
- [x] Final branches and merged code were checked to ensure no work was lost.

### Final Check
- [x] Master QMD was checked after merging all sections.
- [x] Final document was rendered and checked.
- [x] All required files and sections were present and correctly structured.
